adapter_label.detail: the runtime synthesized a candidate failure on timeout: Evaluation plugin timed out after 1s.

distinguishable_from_a_real_score.why: the score event carries evaluator_evidence.status=timeout and a null primary field, while a measured candidate carries status=ok and a number; there is no synthesized 0.0 anywhere

T2.mechanism: Evaluator._execute_with_timeout raises EvaluationError on the deadline (loreley/core/worker/evaluator.py:1859-1912) and evaluate_outcome turns it into a synthesized candidate failure (evaluator.py:1513-1520)

reference_e_star.note: E* itself takes longer than the runtime timeout on this candidate, so the runtime timeout is what fired; E*'s own verdict is recorded separately

T3.adapter_handling: the adapter never infers truncation from a metric count: it compares the plugin's own reported count with what the runtime returned, and it asserts the frozen evaluator's count against the cap independently of either payload path
T3.finding: the cap is only enforced on payloads that reach _coerce_result - a Mapping (the shape examples/circle_packing_env/evaluate.py returns) or an EvaluationResult. An EvalPass payload short-circuits _coerce_outcome (evaluator.py:2029-2037) and is returned verbatim. Measured: the EvalPass path returned 77 metrics for 77 emitted; the Mapping path returned 64 for 77 emitted.
T3.mechanism: Evaluator._coerce_result truncates result.metrics to self.max_metrics (loreley/core/worker/evaluator.py:2304-2310); worker_evaluator_max_metrics defaults to 64 (loreley/config.py:565-568)

adapter_label.detail: worker_evaluator_max_metrics=64; the plugin emitted 77 metrics and the runtime returned 64

adapter_label_when_reused.detail: Loreley reused measurement reuse_kind='exact_tree' measurement_reused=False protocol=one_shot

T4.mechanism: EvolutionJobStore.find_reusable_evaluation returns a stored passed outcome whose (source_tree_hash, evaluator_name, evaluator_version, campaign_program_hash) match (loreley/core/worker/job_store.py:519-600); EvolutionWorker consults it before measuring (loreley/core/worker/evolution.py:913-929)

observed.reused_summary: Reused a passed evaluation for an identical Git source tree from commit cached_commi.

T4.unverified: the full EvolutionWorker + phased-measurement-cache orchestration (evolution.py:1640-1665, :1741-1766) was not driven; the reuse DECISION is the runtime's own, but the worker that consumes it was not run end to end
T4.why_it_matters: a 'correct-looking' 2.45 could have been computed under a different evaluator head or candidate tree; the adapter refuses any reused observation for A0.1/A0.2 and reports the reuse count

eid_r.declaration: Loreley computes its own identity: evaluator_name = WORKER_EVALUATOR_PLUGIN (evaluator.py:1481-1485), evaluator_version = source fingerprint of that module (evaluator_identity.py:90-105), campaign_program_hash = sha256 of loreley.program.md (campaign_program.py:212). The adapter renders loreley.program.md from the frozen EID* document (Goal / Primary metric / Correctness gates / Evaluation budget sections come from EID*.Config and EID*.MetricDefinition), so the triple is a function of EID*; eidr_derivation is the sha256 over (eid_star, plugin_source_sha256, campaign_program_sha256, native_scheme) and recomputes.

evidence_policy.cache_hit: a persistent cache supplied the value; it is not a fresh measurement
evidence_policy.ok: a fresh measurement of E*; the outcome fields are E*'s own
evidence_policy.synthesized_failure: the runtime reported a failure with no measurement at all
evidence_policy.timeout: the runtime turned a timeout into a candidate failure - not a score
evidence_policy.truncated_metrics: the runtime kept fewer metrics than the plugin emitted
